meta.title: Book a demo or start a free trial
meta.description: Tell us about your class and we'll contact you on WhatsApp or by phone, usually within one working day. A 30-minute demo at your institute or on Zoom, or a free trial set up with your classes.

intro.title: See ReMix with your own classes
intro.body: Tell us a little about your class. We'll show you ReMix in a 30-minute demo at your institute or on Zoom, or open a free trial with your classes and fees ready to try.

contact.title: We contact you
contact.body: Someone from our Colombo team messages you on WhatsApp or calls, usually within one working day.

learn.title: We learn how you teach
learn.body: Your classes, fees, how students pay and how they join Zoom. It takes about 15 minutes.

try.title: You see it working
try.body: A live demo, or a trial set up with your own classes, before you decide anything.

intro.student: Are you a student? <link>Find your class</link> instead. This form is for teachers and institutes.

form.title: Tell us about your class

intent.demoHint: 30 minutes, at your institute or on Zoom
intent.trialHint: We set it up with your classes

phone.label: Mobile number
phone.hint: Sri Lankan mobile number, starting with 7

form.whatsappSame: I use WhatsApp on this number

message.label: Anything we should know?
message.placeholder: Subjects, grades, how you run classes today…

form.privacy: We use this only to contact you about ReMix. <link>Privacy policy</link>

turnstile.devNotice: Spam protection isn't configured here (NEXT_PUBLIC_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY is empty), so sending will fail. That's expected in local development.
turnstile.unavailable: The spam check couldn't load. Turn off content blockers for this page and reload, or contact us on WhatsApp.

form.summaryTitle: Please check {count, plural, one {# field} other {# fields}}

name.invalid: Enter your name using 2 to 80 characters

phone.invalid: Enter a Sri Lankan mobile number, like 77 123 4567

institute.required: Enter your institute or class name
institute.invalid: Enter your institute or class name using 2 to 120 characters

students.invalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 100,000

city.invalid: Enter your city or town using 2 to 60 characters

turnstileToken.required: Wait for the spam check below to finish, then send again
turnstileToken.invalid: The spam check expired. Please send again

failure.title: Your request wasn't sent
failure.whatsapp: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a minute, or <link>message us on WhatsApp</link>.
failure.email: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a minute, or email <link>{email}</link>.

verification.title: We couldn't verify your request
verification.body: The spam check didn't pass. Please send again. If it keeps happening, contact us on WhatsApp or by email.

success.title: Thanks, we've got your request
success.body: We'll contact you on {phone} {channel, select, whatsapp {on WhatsApp} other {by phone}}, usually within one working day.
success.note: There's nothing else you need to do. If it's urgent, email {email}.

meta.title: Find your class
meta.description: Your class has its own ReMix website. Type its address to go there, or ask your teacher for your class link.

findClass.title: Find your class
findClass.body: Your teacher's class has its own website on ReMix. Type its address and we'll take you there.
findClass.label: Your class's web address

errors.invalid: That doesn't look like a class address. Use letters, numbers and hyphens, like kamalphysics
errors.reserved: That address belongs to ReMix, not a class. Check the link your teacher sent you
errors.otherDomain: That's a full website address. Type it straight into your browser's address bar instead

ask.title: Ask your teacher for your class link
ask.body: If you don't know the address, ask your teacher or institute. It's usually shared in the class WhatsApp group, on your fee card or on the notice board.

ownDomain.title: Some classes have their own domain
ownDomain.body: Institutes with their own web address, like www.kamalphysics.lk, are reached directly. Type that address into your browser; you don't need remix.lk.

login.title: Logging in happens on your class's site
login.body: remix.lk is the website of ReMix, the company that runs the platform. There's no student login here; your login is on your class's own site.

findClass.teacher: Are you a teacher? <link>See ReMix for teachers</link>
